name: sanction-approvals
description: Request human approval for an exact action and resume through a one-use Sanction grant.

interface.longDescription: Request human review of an exact tool action, then check and redeem its one-use grant when the user resumes. Synthetic tests execute nothing. This cooperative approval workflow does not intercept other tools, install enforcement hooks, or replace host permissions. Requires a Sanction account and connection.
defaultPrompt: Request approval for a synthetic action; execute nothing.
